message.reasoning:
I'm working out the current year to anchor the timeline, and I'll settle on 2026 as my best estimate. Next I'm planning 30 to 35 events stretching out to the year 10000, weighing things like AI, climate, and population trends, while keeping in mind how uncertain the far future is.

I'm deciding whether humanity still exists in 10000 and leaning toward yes, with substantial uncertainty and a real extinction risk, and I'm expecting any surviving descendants to be very different from us. Now I'm sketching the first events of the timeline, starting with AI handling multi-day research tasks by 2027 and a crewed Moon return around 2030.

I'm laying out the remaining milestones, from a crewed Moon landing around 2029-2030, through AI matching human experts around 2032, global warming crossing 1.5°C around 2031, labor disruption and redistribution around 2038, and AI-driven advances in medicine around 2040.

I'm now filling in the later milestones of the timeline, including a major catastrophe in the middle of the century, life expectancy in rich countries passing 100 around 2080, warming peaking near 2.5°C by 2100, and AI systems doing most of the economic work by then. I'm also sketching permanent settlements off Earth by 2120, and the question of AI minds gaining legal recognition, with the timeline stretching on to 2250.

I'm pushing the timeline further out, placing events at roughly 2300 for off-Earth industry and millions living in space habitats, then first interstellar probes around 2400 with one reaching Alpha Centauri by 2500. Around 3000 I'm picturing humanity splitting into several lineages, and by 3500 a first settlement in another star system, followed by languages that have drifted beyond recognition by 4000.

I'm sketching the far end of the timeline now, with a major catastrophe risk sitting around the middle of the period, a Moon and Mars presence that's routine, and early interstellar travel by the year 2500. Further out I'm picturing a split into several human lineages and a first settlement in another star system, then the fading of earthly languages and a partial Dyson swarm by 5000. By 10000 I'm imagining descendants spread over a few hundred light-years, and I want to flag the early-to-mid 2030s as the period of highest existential risk from losing control of AI.

Now I'm weighing whether to add a few near-term items, like AI incidents around 2028 and the first international AI agreements in the 2030s, along with some hedged mention of great-power conflict. I want to keep the timeline's confidence decreasing as it stretches out, and I'll aim for roughly 32 short entries.
